summary: Retest v0.12.0-beta GDPR after fixes for iteration_5's 5 CRITICAL bugs. Re-ran full pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_gdpr_v012.py (20 tests). Result: 20/20 PASSED (was 17/20). All 3 previously failing tests are now GREEN: TestGdprMyData::test_my_data_returns_all, TestCancellazioneLifecycle::test_full_lifecycle, TestImpostazioniSindacato::test_put_superadmin_updates. Regression suite (login/me, rimborsi, sedi, notifiche, /version=0.12.0-beta) also PASSED. Fixes verified: (1) user['id'] used instead of user['_id']; (2) _log_audit called with correct positional target_type + note (not details); (3) tz-aware datetime diff works for stato-cancellazione. v0.12.0-beta is READY FOR DEPLOY from backend perspective.
critical_code_review_comments: All 3 systemic fixes are correctly applied in routes/gdpr.py: user['id'] via ObjectId, _log_audit signature aligned to core/audit.py, and datetime tz-normalization before subtracting mongo-naive vs now(tz=UTC).
Cancellazione lifecycle correctly enforces: single active pending request (second POST -> 400), 28-30 days residui window, cancel then re-cancel -> 404. Good coverage.

Consider adding integration test for effective execution of cancellazione after 30 giorni (cron/scheduler path) — currently only the request/cancel lifecycle is exercised. Non-blocking for this release.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed test_gdpr_* created via /api/auth/register during the run and cleaned up by session-scoped fixture. Additionally, at end of run manually executed db.richieste_cancellazione.delete_many({'stato':'annullata'}) as instructed — 2 records removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v0.12.0-beta GDPR backend fully green (20/20). If future changes touch routes/gdpr.py, rerun `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_gdpr_v012.py -v`. Superadmin creds and cleanup are idempotent.
